course_name_original: Trabajo Fin de Grado ( 2ª mención S. Telecomunicación)
prerequisites: The TFG must be defended and evaluated once there is reliable proof that the student has passed all remaining subjects of the study plan and therefore has all the necessary credits for obtaining the Degree title, except those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: The Bachelor's Thesis is an original exercise to be carried out individually or in a group, which must be presented and defended individually before a university committee. It consists of carrying out a project in the field of the specific technology of the studied Degree, of a professional nature, in which the competencies acquired in the teachings are synthesized and integrated.
General presentation: adherence to standards, legibility, writing, spelling, etc.
Logical and coherent structure in the representation of information, ideas and arguments.
Interest of the author's points of view, judgments, and conclusions.
Quality of the presentation: appropriate use of media, correctness of oral expression, logical structuring, adequacy to available time, etc.
Ability to interest and capture the audience's attention.

The student will generally work on all general competencies of the degree, from CG1 to CG9. Also, depending on the topic of the work, various specific competencies will be worked on. Specifically, in compliance with O.M. CIN/355/2009, it must be a work in which the competencies acquired in the teachings are synthesized and integrated: TFG Competence.

The specific learning outcomes of the bachelor's thesis will vary depending on the topic assigned by the tutor but, as a general rule, will be directly related to the specific objectives of the degree.

These results will be reflected in the individual or group realization of the work, presentation and individual defense before a university committee of an original project in the field of Engineering of a professional nature, in which all acquired competencies are synthesized and integrated.

syllabus_topics: The content of the Bachelor's Thesis, carried out individually by each student, will be framed within one of the work topics included in the Engineering area in which they have pursued their studies, as indicated in the objectives of each degree.

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring of the student's in-person activities by their academic tutor
Final document presented by the student
Public presentation of the work before the committee and subsequent debate

assessment_rules: The Bachelor's Thesis must be presented and defended before a university committee. The final definition of the evaluation system will comply with the regulations defined in the Bachelor's Thesis Regulations of the School of Engineering. Both ordinary and extraordinary evaluation are carried out through a public presentation before a committee of three professors. Although the Bachelor's Thesis may be part of a joint work, the presentation must be individual, clearly indicating each student's particular aspects or contribution.
bibliography: A TFG Regulation of the Polytechnic School of Engineering will be available, which will complement the Generic TFG Regulation of the University of Oviedo (BOPA of July 17, 2012).
A Regulation on the Bachelor's Thesis subject at the University of Oviedo (BOPA of March 30, 2020) will be available.

Both the Generic Regulation and the specific one of the Polytechnic School of Engineering, as well as other related documents (such as the Minutes and the Assessment Matrix, among others) are updated on the Web: https://epigijon.uniovi.es/estudiantes/tfg
